reason: The change wraps script evaluation in a catch-all `catch (Exception)` (not limited to cast errors) that swallows all evaluation failures and silently returns default(T), which could mask genuine script/workflow errors and change behavior for any tenant relying on exceptions propagating from failed workflow expressions.
